answer_1.quote: The task of generating natural language text from knowledge graphs has been extensively studied.
answer_1.outputs: fluent and natural language text from knowledge graphs

answer_2.quote: We use 8 reference-based metrics such as SacreBLEU (Post, 2018), TER , METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005), ChrF++ (Popović, 2017), BERTScore , BLEURT , , SEScore2 . We also evaluate factual alignment with the input graph using reference-less metrics like EREDAT (Scao and Gardent, 2023), FactSpotter .
